diagnosis.root_cause: Deserialization failure caused by an unexpected field 'legacy_promo' in messages at partition 3 offset 88214102, stalling the events-consumer service and causing a massive consumer group lag.
evidence: events-consumer / consumer_group_lag spiked starting at 12:58 UTC from ~490 to over 198,000
2027-03-03T12:55:00Z events-consumer ERROR failed to deserialize message at partition 3 offset 88214102: unexpected field 'legacy_promo'; retrying
2027-03-03T13:05:00Z events-consumer ERROR consumer group lag on 'order-events' now 190000 and rising; partition 3 not advancing
diagnosis.recommended_fix: Mitigation: Skip or poison-pill the malformed message at partition 3 offset 88214102, or deploy a schema update to the events-consumer service to handle the unexpected 'legacy_promo' field. Follow-up: Identify the producer that introduced the unexpected field and establish robust schema validation contracts.
